name: Lev
excerpt: A tall and cheerful coworker of Bokuto at Nekoma's coffeeshop.
notes: Lev works at Nekoma's coffeeshop with Bokuto and Kuroo. He is known for his height and cheerful demeanor. Lev enjoys teasing Bokuto about his crush on Akaashi and is supportive of his friends.
